# Ramani Steel House

> Importer, stockholder, exporter and distributor of nickel alloys, stainless
> steel, titanium, duplex and super duplex materials, based in Mumbai,
> India, and trading since 1974 — 53 years. Material is supplied
> from stock and against order, cut to size, with the mill test certificate for
> the heat supplied.

## What this company is

- Trade role: supplier, stockist, stockholder, distributor, importer and exporter.
  Manufacturing is limited to busbars and sheet metal components; mill products
  are stocked and distributed, not manufactured here.
- Registered address: 65/73, C.P. Tank Road, Mumbai 400004, Maharashtra, India
- GST: 27AAAFR8488B1Z1
- Importer-Exporter Code: 0393066606
- Telephone: +91 22 2242 1388, +91 22 6636 2224
- Email: info@ramanisteel.com

## Certifications

- AS9120:2018 (certificate UQ-2024102430)
- ISO 9001:2015 (certificate 23MEQOO63)

## How to read the material data on this site

- Chemistry and mechanical figures on grade pages are the limits and minimums
  published in the ASTM standard named on the page. They describe the standard,
  not any particular heat. The chemistry and properties of material supplied are
  reported on its mill test certificate.
- Weight charts are calculated from nominal density. They are arithmetic, not a
  stock list.
- Size tables are the ranges recorded in the company's own product listings.
  Availability changes constantly and is confirmed on enquiry.
- Where a designation, standard or property is not confirmed, the page omits it
  rather than estimating.

## Product categories

- [Pure Nickel](https://ramanisteelhouse.github.io/products/pure-nickel/): Commercially pure nickel in grades 200, 201, N6 and 270, held in Mumbai stock for chemical, chlor-alkali, electrical and battery applications.
- [Nickel Alloys & Super Alloys](https://ramanisteelhouse.github.io/products/nickel-alloys/): Nickel-based alloys and super alloys for high-temperature and corrosive service, covering the Inconel, Incoloy, Monel, Hastelloy and Nimonic families.
- [Titanium & Titanium Alloys](https://ramanisteelhouse.github.io/products/titanium/): Commercially pure titanium and titanium alloys from Grade 1 through Grade 23, for aerospace, chemical processing and medical applications.
- [Stainless Steel](https://ramanisteelhouse.github.io/products/stainless-steel/): Austenitic stainless steel in the 300 series, including the low-carbon, high-carbon and stabilised grades used across process and construction industries.
- [Duplex & Super Duplex](https://ramanisteelhouse.github.io/products/duplex-super-duplex/): Duplex and super duplex stainless steel for chloride-bearing and high-strength service, together with the precipitation-hardening grades.
- [6Mo Stainless Steel](https://ramanisteelhouse.github.io/products/6mo-stainless/): Super-austenitic 6-molybdenum stainless steel for seawater, desalination and high-chloride duty where 316L is not sufficient.
- [Special Stainless Steel](https://ramanisteelhouse.github.io/products/special-stainless/): Heat-resistant and specialised corrosion-resistant stainless grades for furnace, kiln and aggressive chemical environments.
- [Busbars & Nickel Strip](https://ramanisteelhouse.github.io/products/busbars/): Nickel strip punched to your cell layout, plus copper, aluminium, nickel-plated and clad busbars for lithium-ion packs in EV, solar and energy storage.
- [Metal Powder for AM](https://ramanisteelhouse.github.io/products/metal-powder/): Gas-atomised, spherical metal powder for additive manufacturing — nine alloys across iron, nickel, titanium, cobalt and aluminium, stocked in five particle size cuts.

## Titanium by form

Titanium is supplied as sheet, plate and round bar. It is not supplied as pipe or tube.

- [Titanium Sheets](https://ramanisteelhouse.github.io/products/titanium-sheets/): ASTM B265 / ASME SB-265, sizes, weight chart, grades
- [Titanium Plates](https://ramanisteelhouse.github.io/products/titanium-plates/): ASTM B265 / ASME SB-265, sizes, weight chart, grades
- [Titanium Round Bars](https://ramanisteelhouse.github.io/products/titanium-round-bars/): ASTM B348 / ASME SB-348, sizes, weight chart, grades

## Industries served

- [Aerospace](https://ramanisteelhouse.github.io/industries/aerospace/): Titanium, nickel super alloys and precipitation-hardening stainless for airframe, engine and fastener applications.
- [Oil & Gas](https://ramanisteelhouse.github.io/industries/oil-and-gas/): Duplex, super duplex, 6Mo and nickel alloys for downhole, offshore and sour-service conditions.
- [Chemical](https://ramanisteelhouse.github.io/industries/chemical/): Corrosion-resistant alloys for reactors, heat exchangers and piping in acid and chloride service.
- [Pharmaceutical](https://ramanisteelhouse.github.io/industries/pharmaceutical/): Hygienic-grade stainless steel and nickel alloys for process vessels, piping and clean-in-place systems.
- [Automobile](https://ramanisteelhouse.github.io/industries/automobile/): Stainless steel, nickel strip and precision components for vehicle systems and battery assemblies.
- [EV Battery](https://ramanisteelhouse.github.io/industries/ev-battery/): Nickel strip, busbars and clad conductors for lithium-ion cell interconnection in EV, solar and energy storage packs.
- [Construction](https://ramanisteelhouse.github.io/industries/construction/): Structural and architectural stainless steel for building, infrastructure and cladding applications.
- [Electrical](https://ramanisteelhouse.github.io/industries/electrical/): Pure nickel, copper and plated conductors for electrical connection, contact and current-carrying components.
